speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
text: asked the Minister for Transport with the growing vulnerability of mobile devices and data being compromised via public charging stations and wifi access points (a) whether there have been any recorded attempts to breach such stations and points at our public transport nodes; (b) what measures are in place to secure these nodes to reduce the risk of compromise for users; and (c) whether the Ministry will implement public education measures, such as billboards at MRT stations, to remind users to take precautions to protect their devices and data.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
text: Only power transmission pins are present in the ports.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
text: The PTOs' staff can pick up signs of physical tampering through regular visual inspection and feedback from commuters.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
text: Closed-circuit television cameras can also detect and deter such attempts.

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: I just have a very short supplementary question.

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: How often are the checks and inspections on these charging stations to ensure that they are not being tampered with or compromised on our public transport system?

speaker: Mr S Iswaran
text: They are trained to pay particular attention to this, as I elaborated earlier.
